entries.text: Result bundles are now written as schema 2.4: run.timing_method, run.net_estimate_status, per-query request_count and result_bytes, platform timing captured by platform statement ID, and client_link.probed_at.
details: Adapters that record timing_method 2 measure only the query: tag setup, statistics and history lookups, validation, digests and plan capture run outside the timer. Full result receipt stays inside it.
Results recorded before this change are timing method 1. Compare, report and rankings work within one timing method and refuse to mix methods.
net_estimate_status is never eligible until an adapter passes the conformance rule in the locality ADR.
